about.legislature: Congress: House of Representatives (435) and Senate (100)

offices.President: Elected every four years through the Electoral College. Each state gets electors equal to its seats in Congress, and almost all award them winner-take-all. 270 of 538 wins.
offices.Senate: Two senators per state serving six-year terms. About a third of seats are up every two years, so most states do not vote for the Senate in a given cycle.
offices.Governors: Each state elects its own governor, mostly for four-year terms. Races are spread across the cycle, with the largest group in midterm years.
offices.House of Representatives: All 435 seats are elected every two years in single-member districts, apportioned to states by population. 218 is a majority.
